Synopsis:
Halsin exits the portal and carries in his arms the Spirit of the Land before setting him down, while the portal to the shadowfell closes. He realises something is wrong with the boy and takes him away to the campsite for examination

Cluster Contexts:
- HAV_HalsinQuest_PortalEmerge.json: Halsin has just completed a draining ritual to reach Thaniel, the spirit of the land, and stepped through a portal into the Shadowfell alone as required; the player was told to wait at the shore, keep the portal open, and fend off attacking shadow creatures while he went in. He emerges carrying an unconscious fey boy (Thaniel) and sets him down as the portal closes, then realizes Thaniel is harmed or altered and carries him back to the campsite for examination. Off‑screen beats include the player having recovered Art’s instrument and talked with Art (information Halsin used to pinpoint Thaniel), and the knowledge that Halsin’s ritual sapped his strength—his ability to continue and whether he can rejoin the party later depends on how much of Thaniel can be restored. The scene also sits before later encounters tied to Oliver/the stolen heart, which influence whether Thaniel can be fully healed.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_Portal.json: The player has already recovered Art’s instrument from the Surgeon and talked to Art, information Halsin used to pinpoint Thaniel’s location in the Shadowfell. Halsin is a druid acting with the Oak Father’s blessing who must enter the Shadowfell alone to retrieve Thaniel—the spirit of the land—because the ritual requires only him and will sap his strength. He asks the player to wait a short distance from Last Light at the shore, keep the portal open, and defend it until he returns; shortly after he goes through, shadow creatures attack and the player must hold them off. If the player attempts to follow through the portal, the ritual will fail.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_PortalEntry.json: Halsin has been conducting a ritual to open a portal to the Shadowfell while the player defends him from attacking shadows. In this case, the player interfered with the portal (trying to enter it themselves) causing it to collapse. Halsin reacts, aghast. His one chance to infiltrate the Shadowfell and lift the shadow curse has been lost. He expresses his anger to the player and walks off. Ultimately he will part ways from us for good sometime soon after.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_Spirit.json: The player tries to interact with Thaniel, the spirit of the land, after Halsin rescues him from the Shadowfell. Thaniel is unconscious/unresponsive however.Later - Thaniel is recovering and able to talk. A somewhat otherworldly, wise far beyond his years 'child'. He instructs you on what comes next/offers his thanks once you have succeeded.
- HAV_HalsinQuest_AD_HalsinCombat.json: Halsin is conducting a ritual on the shore near Last Light to open a portal into the Shadowfell to reach Thaniel, the land spirit whose fragmented essence must be reunited. You have already found Art’s instrument and spoken with Art, which Halsin used to pinpoint Thaniel’s location; Halsin insists he must go alone and warns you not to follow. While he chants the incantation the player (and any companions) must hold the portal open and fend off shadow creatures that press the ritual—if Halsin steps through the exchange ends and the attack intensifies. This sequence can lead into a later encounter with Oliver, a shadow-child tied to Thaniel’s heart, and Halsin’s ultimate availability afterward depends on how much of Thaniel is restored.

context: Halsin performed a draining ritual and stepped alone through a portal into the Shadowfell to retrieve Thaniel; the player had been told to wait at the shore, keep the portal open, and fend off shadow attackers, and had already recovered Art’s instrument and spoken with Art (information Halsin used to pinpoint Thaniel). He emerges carrying the unconscious fey boy, lays him down as the portal closes, and immediately realizes Thaniel has been harmed or altered. Weaker from the ritual, Halsin lifts Thaniel and takes him back to the campsite to examine and attempt to heal him. Whether Halsin can rejoin the party and how fully Thaniel can be restored depends on how much of the spirit’s essence is recoverable and on later events tied to Oliver/the stolen heart.
